mapper.sql: id, project_id, system_code, #{assetType} AS asset_type, doc_code AS asset_code, doc_name AS asset_name, structured_data, owner_id, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ${table} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted = 0 AND (doc_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR doc_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${table} (id, tenant_id, project_id, system_code, doc_code, doc_name, structured_data, owner_id, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{projectId}, #{systemCode}, #{docCode}, #{docName}, #{structuredData}, #{ownerId}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ${table} WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = #{deleted}
mapper.update: UPDATE ${table} SET system_code = #{systemCode}, doc_name = #{docName}, structured_data = #{structuredData}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE ${table} SET deleted = 1, deleted_by = #{deletedBy}, deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT , deleted_by, deleted_at FROM ${table} WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ${table} SET deleted = 0, deleted_by = NULL, deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ${table} WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 1
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dm_component WHERE system_code = #{systemCode} AND project_id = #{projectId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND enabled = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dm_operation_log (tenant_id, actor_id, project_id, operation_code, entity_type, entity_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{actorId}, #{projectId}, #{operation}, 'ASSET', #{entityId})
